name: RBC Avion Visa Infinite

apr.notes: 20.99% on purchases; 22.99% on cash advances. Quebec residents may have a different purchase rate.

fx_fee.notes: RBC does not publish the foreign transaction fee on the product page; confirm the current percentage in the RBC cardholder agreement.

credit_required.notes: Minimum personal income of $60,000 or household income of $100,000.

base_rate.description: 1 Avion point per $1 on all other eligible purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Avion points redeem for travel, gift cards, merchandise, statement credits and transfers to partner programs.

signup_bonus.description: Up to 70,000 Avion points: 35,000 on approval, 20,000 after spending $5,000 in the first 6 months, and a 15,000 one-time anniversary bonus. Offer advertised for applications by 2026-11-25.

benefits.title: Out of Province/Country Emergency Medical Insurance
benefits.description: Unlimited emergency medical coverage for eligible trips, subject to the RBC certificate of insurance.

benefits.title: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for accidental death or dismemberment while travelling on a common carrier, subject to the certificate of insurance.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision/Loss Damage Waiver Insurance
benefits.description: Waives collision or loss damage liability on eligible rental vehicles when the card is used to pay.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation & Trip Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement for eligible non-refundable travel costs when a trip is cancelled or interrupted for a covered reason.

benefits.title: Delayed Baggage and Flight Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for essential expenses when checked baggage or a flight is delayed beyond the policy waiting period.

benefits.title: Hotel/Motel Burglary Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for loss of eligible property due to burglary while staying at a hotel or motel.

benefits.title: Purchase Security & Extended Warranty Insurance
benefits.description: Protects eligible purchases against loss, theft, or damage and doubles the manufacturer warranty up to the policy limits.

benefits.title: Mobile Device Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for eligible mobile devices that are lost, stolen, or damaged when purchased with the card.

benefits.title: Visa Infinite Hotel Collection
benefits.description: Access to the Visa Infinite Hotel Collection with benefits such as room upgrades and breakfast at participating properties.

notes: Network tier is Visa Infinite per the card name.
